If such a character is found, then it is possible to rearrange s' < t'. If no such character is found after iterating through both strings, then it is not possible to satisfy s' < t'.

Consider the case where one string is a prefix of the other, but ensure that the remaining characters in the longer string do not form a lexicographically smaller sequence than the remaining characters in the shorter string.
